title: Orders with streams
description:
Answer questions about orders with the Stream API.

```
Total revenue: 1,055.00
Revenue by customer: {Ada=420.00, Bob=500.00, Cy=135.00}
Biggest order: #4 (300.00)
Products ordered: [Keyboard, Monitor, Mouse]
Average order: 150.71
```
hints: `max(Comparator.comparingDouble(Order::amount))` returns an `Optional<Order>`; equal amounts keep the first.
requirements: `record Order(int id, String customer, String product, double amount)`.
Each answer is one stream pipeline: `mapToDouble().sum()`, `Collectors.groupingBy` with `summingDouble`, `max`, `map().distinct().sorted()`, `average()`.
Use a `TreeMap` for the grouping so it prints in order.
stretch: Group by customer and then by product into a nested map.
